modeBoundary: Classic live party coordination uses a STRONG six-member cap; unresolved leader/rank/disconnect edges remain gated.

integrations.movement: returns deterministic follower movement requests without bypassing movement validation
integrations.combat: NPC XP eligibility is owned by exact-NPC active combat at death, not party membership; party service does not calculate XP.
integrations.economy: Monster currency/items are not auto-split by party state; explicit SHARE owns voluntary currency distribution.
integrations.quests: does not calculate shared quest credit
integrations.sessions: accepts connected/disconnected state and preserves policy boundary

safeFallbacks: unknown party membership rejects the operation
followers move only when connected, opted in, and co-located with the leader
offline members do not receive party chat delivery

strongNativeFindings.frontBackBalance: front rank count must be at least back rank count
strongNativeFindings.joinFollow: JOIN/FOLLOW after invite begins following immediately
strongNativeFindings.lootBoundary: monster currency drops to room; no automatic party loot split promoted
